en: Points of Controversy The Great Fifty-Section The Fifth Chapter
The Discourse on Knowledge of the Future: Is there knowledge regarding the future?
Yes, [it is] so.
Does one know the future from its root, know it from its cause, know it from its source, know it from its origin, know it from its production,
know it from its arising, know it from its nutriment, know it from its object, know it from its condition, and know it from its origination?
It should not be said thus … [as before] … Is there knowledge regarding the future? Yes.

Does one know the future as a condition by way of cause-condition, as a condition by way of object, as a condition by way of predominance, as a condition by way of proximity, and as a condition by way of contiguity?
One should not say so... [etc.
...Is there knowledge regarding the future?
“Yes,” [you say].
“Does a person who is a lineage-holder (gotrabhū) possess knowledge of the path of stream-entry?
You should not say so… [and so on]…
Is it to be said that for a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of stream-entry, there is knowledge regarding the fruit of stream-entry?
Certainly not; [the same applies] to the once-returner... etc.
Is there knowledge of arahantship for a person who has entered upon the practice for the realization of arahantship, as there is for a non-returner?
One should not say so... [and so on].
Is it not to be said that "there is knowledge regarding the future"?
Yes, it is.
But was it not said by the Blessed One:
“Ānanda, there will be three obstacles for Pāṭaliputta:
either from fire, or from water, or from internal dissension”?
Is it indeed a sutta?
Yes. Therefore, there is knowledge of the future.
The Discussion on Knowledge of the Future is finished.
